$schemaNote: Audited gateway inventory with a bounded source-parity gate. The compiler parses FORWARDED_JSON_PATHS, APP_DATA_PREFIXES, KIT_ROUTE, KIT_STREAM_ROUTE, and exact path === literals from cloudflare/src/gateway.js and fails when this fixture does not list them. Imperative prefix/catch-all semantics beyond those declared seams remain hand-audited. Hosted-adapter Rule 11 continues to join the system/control entries by (method, path, operation), while appDataPlane covers the app-data dispatch and unsupported-target fallback namespaces.
scope: Source-parity covers exact path literals, forwarded JSON paths, kit regex families, and the app-data prefixes protected from SPA fallback. Rule 11's hosted-adapter catalog join remains scoped to system/control entries; static-asset and general SPA behavior remain outside that catalog domain.

entries.description: Returns the app's capability manifest (LLP 0040 §Capability report). No method check in code; served as an unconditional 200 JSON read regardless of verb.
Alias of /inspect; same handler, same capabilityManifest response.

methods: ANY (forwarded to coordinator hard-coded as POST)
entries.gate: per-invocation host-call token (x-snapback-host-token / x-snapback-do-id); not the admin model
entries.description: Re-entrant host call from the handler isolate back to the coordinator that owns the live invocation. The coordinator DO id rides x-snapback-do-id. gateway.js always forwards as POST to the coordinator regardless of the caller's original method (see @ref LLP 0031#the-invariant in source).

methods: ANY (forwarded to coordinator hard-coded as GET, no explicit method passed)
entries.description: Coordinator health/build-identity check. gateway.js does not forward request.method; the stub.fetch call carries no method override, so it always issues a GET to the coordinator.

entries.gate: hosted admin token (x-snapback-admin-token), GET-only per LLP 0031's amendment (gateway.js itself does not enforce the GET-only restriction — that lives in the coordinator)
entries.description: Operator config diagnosis: names, set/missing state, grants, generation — never values. Forwarded with the caller's method and headers, no body.

entries.gate: public bounded typed projection; admin token escalates to scrubbed operator detail
entries.description: Cron ledger/activation status. Forwarded with the caller's method and headers, no body.

entries.gate: hosted admin token, POST-only per LLP 0031's amendment (enforced downstream by the coordinator, not gateway.js)
entries.description: Admin-gated manual cron run trigger. Forwarded with the caller's method and headers; body forwarded unless the method is GET.

LLP 0167 runtime network-profile selector, read side. gateway.js hand-routes ALL methods for this single path to the coordinator (no method-level branch in gateway.js itself); the coordinator is the one that dispatches GET/HEAD through the admin-read gate. This is the RFC's worked example of why manifest entries must be keyed by (method, path, operation), not path alone — GET and every write method share this path but carry different authority, effect, and schema.

LLP 0167 runtime network-profile selector, write side. Same gateway.js route as the read entry above (gateway.js forwards method+body unchanged for every method except GET/HEAD, which drop the body); the coordinator dispatches any write method through the admin-write activation gate. Missing from LLP 0031's hosted route table prior to this audit (corrected — see the 2026-08-05 dated correction in llp/0031-server-route-taxonomy.spec.md).

entries.registrationStyle: exact-path (member of the FORWARDED_JSON_PATHS Set; also matches the /_snapback/test/ prefix wildcard below, so both registration styles reach this path)
entries.gate: SNAPBACK_TESTING=1 profile gate (categorically absent from production deploys); POST-only enforced by gateway.js itself (405 otherwise)
entries.description: Testing seam that must stay reachable during a startup metadata-corruption refusal, so it is enumerated by exact path rather than relying only on the /_snapback/test/ prefix. Forwarded generically via the shared forward() helper (always POST to the coordinator).

entries.gate: SNAPBACK_TESTING=1 profile gate; POST-only enforced by gateway.js itself (405 otherwise)
entries.description: Generic testing-seam prefix (formerly /__test/* pre-migration, per LLP 0031's dated amendment). gateway.js forwards any path under this prefix to the identically-named coordinator path via the shared forward() helper; the specific operation identity per subpath is not determinable from gateway.js alone (coordinator-owned).

entries.gate: hosted admin token; mutex-serialized atomic reset (coordinator-enforced, POST-only per LLP 0031)
entries.description: Destructive admin app reset. gateway.js forwards only method+headers (no body) and never mints admin authority itself — the coordinator enforces the POST-only, token-gated admin surface (ENG-23587).
Destructive admin object eviction — the RFC's confirmed worked example of a hand-routed hosted control path with no RouteClass entry. gateway.js forwards only method+headers (no body).

entries.registrationStyle: exact-path (OR'd into the same branch as the /_snapback/ prefix catch-all)
entries.description: Bare reserved-namespace root with no trailing segment; falls into the same explicit-404 branch as the prefix catch-all below.

entries.registrationStyle: catch-all prefix (path.startsWith('/_snapback/'), evaluated after every exact/prefix match above)
entries.description: Any /_snapback/* path not matched by one of the entries above returns an explicit JSON 404 (SNAPBACK_ROUTE_UNKNOWN). /_snapback/* never falls through to the SPA asset lane — this is what keeps the reserved namespace exhaustively system-owned on the hosted arm (LLP 0031's dated amendment).

excludedNonSystemPaths.note: Enumerated during the same full read of gateway.js for audit completeness and to sanity-check that no registration style was missed; these are app-data-plane or asset-serving routes, not system/control, so they are excluded from 'entries' above per RFC 0184 §3a scope.

items.registrationStyle: exact-path (FORWARDED_JSON_PATHS Set member); also the Channel A subrequest target
prefix wildcard (path.startsWith('/__exact/')); Exact protocol endpoints served from the assets binding, never SPA-fallback
catch-all fallthrough to env.ASSETS.fetch(request) (static web bundle / Channel A inlined HTML), or an explicit JSON 404 when no assets binding is configured

registrationStylesConfirmed: a final catch-all (env.ASSETS.fetch fallback, or explicit JSON 404 with no assets binding)
